features_and_traits: Your Cleric has additional spells available to them, as designated in Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

You can cast prepared cleric spells using WIS as your spellcasting modifier (Spell DC 13, Spell Attack +5) and prepared cleric spells as rituals if they have the ritual tag. You can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus.
You choose a divine domain that grants you additional spells and other features related to your deity.
You gain proficiency with martial weapons.
You learn one necromancy cantrip from any spell list. When you cast a necromancy cantrip that normally targets only one creature, it can instead target two creatures within 5 ft. of each other.
You have a bite attack for 1d6 +0 piercing damage that can be used instead of the normal damage for an unarmed strike.
As part of a short rest, you can create a shield, club, javelin, darts, or blowgun needles from materials from slain creatures.
You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.
You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Nature, Perception, Stealth, and Survival.
When you aren’t wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. A shield’s benefits apply as normal.
Once per short rest as a bonus action, you can make a bite attack. If it hits, you gain 3 temporary HP.

roleplay_anchors.personality_traits:
I see omens in every event and action. The gods try to speak to us, we just need to listen. 
I quote (or misquote) sacred texts
roleplay_anchors.ideals: Aspiration. I seek to prove myself worthy of my god’s favor by matching my actions against his or her
roleplay_anchors.bonds: I will do anything to protect the temple where I served.
roleplay_anchors.flaws: My piety sometimes leads me to blindly trust those that profess faith in my god.
